company_name: Fuzhou Palead Electronics Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Fuzhou Palead Electronics Technology Co., Ltd specializes in integrated circuit testing and sorting machines, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Fuzhou Palead Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. is a national high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D, production, and sales of integrated circuit chip testing and sorting machines, as well as tape/reel machines. The company has a strong R&D team and has received multiple awards for its innovations in the semiconductor field.
capabilities: PH-010 Series: Isolator & Optocoupler & IPM Sorting System
PH-200 Series: Integrated Circuit Single-Rail Dual-Position Automatic Sorting System
PH-300 Series: Semiconductor Device Automatic Sorting System
PH-600 Series: Multi-Rail Multi-Position Automatic Sorting System

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Fuzhou, China, and has established itself as a key player in the local semiconductor equipment market.
